signed_rows.behavior: The okf add argument matches a scaccogatto settings entry: repo[#ref] for github, url[#ref] for git, url for url, path for directory, and scaccogatto/okf-skills when no entry exists.
signed_rows.fails_when: for any kind, with or without a ref, the argument kmctl passes to marketplace add is not the one listed, or with no entry it is not scaccogatto/okf-skills

signed_rows.behavior: A managed settings entry (managed-settings.json or a json file in managed-settings.d) wins over the user settings entry.
signed_rows.fails_when: with entries in both, kmctl uses the user entry, or ignores a managed-settings.d file

signed_rows.behavior: An entry no add argument can match (a github path, headers, or an unknown kind) stops the install before claude runs, with a message naming the settings file.
signed_rows.fails_when: such an entry does not raise PluginError, the message does not name the file, or claude is called

signed_rows.behavior: With user settings that declare scaccogatto from a git URL, kmctl plugin install succeeds at project scope with okf installed, without editing the settings.
signed_rows.fails_when: in an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME whose user settings declare scaccogatto from https://github.com/scaccogatto/okf-skills.git, kmctl plugin install exits nonzero, okf is not installed, or the user settings file changed

signed_rows.behavior: The other plugin install tests still pass.
signed_rows.fails_when: any test in tests/test_plugin_install.py or tests/test_plugin.py fails

resigns.reason: plan round 1 review: the add argument must carry ref, entries with a path cannot be passed, and managed settings files are named
